items.title: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies
items.title_cn: 人工智能代理可以进行开放式的人工智能研究吗？两个案例研究的早期证据
items.summary: Forecasts of explosive AI progress hinge on AI agents automating AI research. But evidence on whether agents can carry out open-ended AI research is thin. Current evaluations either test agents on narrow, verifiable tasks, which excludes open-ended research, or submit AI-generated papers to blind pe...
items.summary_cn: 人工智能爆炸性进展的预测取决于人工智能代理自动化人工智能研究。但是，关于智能体是否可以进行开放式人工智能研究的证据很少。当前的评估要么是针对狭隘、可验证的任务（不包括开放式研究）进行测试，要么是将AI生成的论文提交给盲人...
items.comment: 论文看着高大上，代码开源了吗？复现了吗？别光说不练。

items.summary: Conversational AI is increasingly positioned as a teammate rather than a tool, yet we know little about how its presence reshapes communication among the humans on the team. We examined sociocognitive communication dynamics in team decision-making using Group Communication Analysis (GCA), team surve...
items.summary_cn: 对话式人工智能越来越多地被定位为队友而非工具，但我们对其存在如何重塑团队中人类之间的沟通知之甚少。我们使用团队沟通分析（ GCA ）、团队调查研究了团队决策中的社会认知沟通动态...
